glas.title: Supervision Repairs a Near-Collapse Case
glas.summary: The training-free CFC branch nearly misses the gland entirely here. Both supervised heads recover the structure, and the best coarse-only readout edges the all-scales head again.

glas.title: Coarse-Only Can Beat the Multiscale Head Cleanly
glas.summary: This crop is a useful reminder that the best current result is not just a width effect. The coarse-only d128 head is visibly cleaner than the all-scales d64 baseline.

glas.title: Coarse-Only Is Strongest Overall, But Not Universal
glas.summary: The strongest aggregate result is coarse-only, but this crop is a good counterexample. The all-scales d64 head is actually better here than the best coarse-only run.

glas.title: Better Readout First, Then Extra Width
glas.summary: CFC is weak, the all-scales head improves it, and the best coarse-only head improves further. This is representative of the current coarse-dominant readout story.

glas.title: A Real Failure Case Still Exists
glas.summary: This crop stays difficult for the supervised frozen-feature heads and is worth keeping visible. The current page is not claiming that the readout fully dominates every CFC sample.

monuseg.title: Residual Refinement Produces a Clear MoNuSeg Leap
monuseg.summary: This is the strongest single-sample gain in the current MoNuSeg set. The native coarse-only run barely changes the strict 512x512 baseline, while the coarse+mid residual branch sharpens the nucleus map immediately.

monuseg.title: When Coarse-Only Stalls, the Mid-Scale Branch Can Rescue It
monuseg.summary: This crop matters because it shows the structural story more clearly than the averages. The small residual branch adds a real correction, not just a cosmetic smoothing effect.

monuseg.title: The Best MoNuSeg Head Still Helps Even When the Baseline Is Decent
monuseg.summary: The strict 512x512 baseline is already respectable on this crop, but the residual branch still improves it. That is why the page treats the MoNuSeg gain as a readout effect, not just a rescue-on-failures effect.

monuseg.title: The MoNuSeg Refinement Branch Is Strong, Not Magic
monuseg.summary: This crop is one of the smallest positive deltas. Keeping it visible prevents the section from overstating the improvement and makes the average gain easier to trust.
